capabilities: arrange text, images, tables, charts, calendars, and formulas on an infinite block canvas
handwrite on pages with pressure-sensitive pen, highlighter, and eraser tools
annotate PDF and EPUB books with highlights, thumbnails, and a bookshelf
study videos with timestamps, A-B loops, picture-in-picture, and frame capture
keep notes as Markdown files with optional JSON layout sidecars
extras: Desktop-only: relies on local PDF rendering, Windows OCR, file system access, and video picture-in-picture. OCR is optional. Not yet approved in the Obsidian community plugin directory; keeps the plugin id onenote-native for settings and data compatibility with earlier versions.
problem: Obsidian notes are document-based, so free-form page layouts, handwriting, and embedded reader or study panels require separate apps or plugins.
summary: OneNote-style notebook that edits Markdown notes on an infinite block canvas with handwriting, video study tools, and PDF/EPUB annotations.
